message: The other day, I was trying to explain to my grandkids why we need to have a storm kit ready, and they looked at me like I was asking them to eat broccoli for dessert. I guess the idea of being prepared isn’t quite as exciting as their video games. But hey, if a storm rolls in, I’ll be the one sitting cozy with snacks while they’re busy looking for flashlights. What little preparations do you make that your kids just don’t get?
